title: Two nanosized cage-like Ln20Ni21 clusters exhibiting antiferromagnetic properties

synthesis.procedure: Nd2O3, nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate and iminodiacetic acid were stirred in distilled water and ethanol for 12 h at room temperature. The solution was adjusted to pH 5.0 with aqueous HCl and NaOH, sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, and heated under autogenous pressure at 170 °C for 7 days. After cooling, the green block crystals were washed with ethanol and dried at room temperature for 24 h.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature during stirring; 170 °C during autoclave heating
synthesis.time: 12 h stirring; 7 days heating; 24 h drying
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave; solvothermal, autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; green block crystals washed with ethanol and dried at room temperature for 24 h.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A cage-like Nd20Ni21 core has 20 inner Nd(III) ions encircled by 21 peripheral Ni(II) ions. The framework is described as two umbrella-shaped [Nd10Ni12] units sharing three Ni ions in one plane.

synthesis.procedure: The supporting information states that compound 2 was prepared by a procedure similar to that for 1, with a rare-earth oxide substitution, and reports a 46% yield based on Ni. Its substitution sentence reverses the Nd and Pr oxide names relative to the unambiguous Pr composition of compound 2; the Pr oxide quantity is therefore not assigned. The shared procedure stirs nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate and iminodiacetic acid in water and ethanol for 12 h, adjusts the solution to pH 5.0, then heats it in a sealed autoclave at 170 °C for 7 days before cooling, washing and drying.
